title: Offline preparation and datasets
subtitle: Which dataset feeds which preparation step. Nothing here runs inside a session.

nodes.label: DS-0001
nodes.title: VitalDB
nodes.text: IN USE (aggregates). Vital-sign noise: spread and AR(1) autocorrelation per channel for the monitor and LitePhysio.

nodes.label: DS-0002
nodes.title: PTB-XL
nodes.text: IN USE. Lead II beat templates (sinus, sinus tachycardia, AF) and real strips with reports.

nodes.label: DS-0003
nodes.title: MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demo
nodes.text: REFERENCE AND TESTS ONLY. Plausibility check of lab bands and generated results; lab percentiles p5 to p95 per analyte.

nodes.label: DS-0004
nodes.title: MIMIC-IV-ED Demo
nodes.text: IN USE (aggregates). Triage vitals of ED patients with abdominal complaints (S2 arrival realism).

nodes.label: DS-0005
nodes.title: UIdataGB gallbladder ultrasound
nodes.text: IN USE. Real gallbladder ultrasound pictures for the EMR viewer.

nodes.label: DS-0006
nodes.title: NIH ChestX-ray14
nodes.text: IN USE. Real chest X-rays (consolidation, effusion, pneumothorax, cardiomegaly, oedema, atelectasis, no finding) and the base of the free-air film.

nodes.label: DS-0007
nodes.title: openFDA Drug Label API
nodes.text: IN USE. Contraindication and boxed-warning wording for medicine groups (never doses).

nodes.label: DS-0008
nodes.title: Regensburg Pediatric Appendicitis
nodes.text: NOT USED. None (licence not confirmed; paediatric).

nodes.label: DS-0009

nodes.label: DS-0010

nodes.label: DS-0011

nodes.text: IN USE (DRAFT). Labelled stand-ins where no real image exists (ADR-0003).

nodes.text: DRAFT. Search-the-right-patient task.

nodes.label: OFF-01
nodes.title: Dataset inventory and licence check
nodes.text: Partly built. Keep the dataset register complete: source, version, licence, access date, what is used and how.

nodes.label: OFF-02
nodes.title: Normal versus abnormal profiling per modality
nodes.text: Built. Describe each modality before any generator is designed: distribution of normal values, abnormal patterns per condition, borderline zones… Plans: A66, B14, B15.

nodes.label: OFF-03
nodes.title: Generator parameter packs (versioned)
nodes.text: Built. Turn the profiles into small versioned JSON packs the live generators read: per analyte and condition a distribution (band, centre, spread, skew, truncation)… Plans: B14.

nodes.label: OFF-04
nodes.title: Block library (requires/excludes)
nodes.text: Partly built. The 21 block types of the composer (DEM, PRES, CMB, MED, ALG, PSH, SOC, OBS, FND, RSK, LAB, IMG, CON, PER, PAIN, DIFF, EVT, ENV, STAFF… Plans: A1, A12, E58.

nodes.label: OFF-05
nodes.title: Retrieval index over approved content
nodes.text: Built. Tag index plus lexical (BM25) index over case files, blocks, bands, critical results, what-ifs and source-register snippets, each entry carrying its SR id. Plans: E58.

nodes.label: OFF-06
nodes.title: Media asset index (images and ECG strips)
nodes.text: Built. Every picture and strip with its finding tags, modality, view, quality grade, real or synthetic flag, dataset id and licence. Plans: B15, B16, B17.

nodes.label: OFF-07
nodes.title: Evaluation reference sets
nodes.text: Partly built. Gold scenarios, deliberately broken scenarios, adversarial questions, labelled utterances… Plans: A9, B19, E50, E51.

nodes.label: OFF-08
nodes.title: Model preparation (no training)
nodes.text: Partly built. Download the candidate served models, record their digests and licences, and benchmark latency, VRAM… Plans: E57, E61, E65, E69.

nodes.label: OFF-09
nodes.title: Prompt and schema registry
nodes.text: Built. Versioned prompts and JSON schemas for every model call (composition, dialogue, debrief, classifier, judge).

nodes.label: OFF-10
nodes.title: Scenario knowledge base construction (A66)
nodes.text: Partly built. Typed relations (condition-finding, test-finding, decision-consequence, interactions) imported from verified tables… Plans: A66.
